approval_source.rationale: Existing M002 closeout context and assessment explicitly preserve R009/R010/R011, keep Hermes and GSD-Pi runtime execution proof-gated and unpromoted, and accept conservative fail-closed closeout only when blocker evidence is not promoted.

deferred: Live Hermes resultJson.bos runtime proof is deferred until supported Paperclip operator auth and adapter testEnvironment access are available.
Live gsdpi_local BosAdapterResult runtime proof is deferred until a reachable supported Paperclip runtime exposes registry, health, version, and testEnvironment routes with operator auth.
narrowed: S12 closeout accepts only the explicit no-promotion blocker posture for unavailable runtime surfaces; fail-closed evidence remains diagnostic and is not promoted to runtime proof.

R009/R010/R011 remain intact: capability promotion still requires future passing supported-boundary proof, Hermes proof still requires exactly one bounded run/readback and resultJson.bos, and supported boundaries remain mandatory.
